scope: All final tool findings occur in citation quote strings, replicated across five graph/citation outputs. API routes, container paths and relative code imports inside quoted source text are not structured graph file references.

manifestNormalization.reason: Installed Graphify 0.17.1 Windows manifest writer returns absolute Windows keys and merges older still-existing entries.
manifestNormalization.normalization: Only manifest metadata regenerated from the actual 146 detected files with relative keys and the same mtime/MD5 schema. Graph, ontology and Studio data were not directly edited.

provenance.freshness: Git hash is the pre-commit parent HEAD; tracked scope includes staged current source. Use manifest hashes for source freshness after the containing commit.
provenance.assistantTokenCounters: Unmetered zero placeholders, not evidence of zero assistant usage.
provenance.reportCapture: Final portable-check output captured outside scan directory before copying into publication, to avoid recursive scanning of an earlier tool report.

decision: Retain the genuine non-passing tool report and the grounded citations. Structured source references and the normalized bounded manifest are relative and current. This manual review does not claim that Graphify portable-check passed.
